title: the office fish guy and the 990 lb piano
description:
Office etiquette, tested by physics: a 990 lb grand piano does not care who microwaves fish.

The useless facts:
- A nine-foot concert grand piano (like the Steinway Model D, 274 cm long) weighs about 990 pounds.
- Microwaving fish at the office is the most hated break-room habit in America. The piano does not care. The office, however, claps.

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. What's the worst thing someone has microwaved at your job?

Sources:
- Steinway & Sons (UK), Model D specifications (274 cm, 990 lb / 480 kg): https://steinway.co.uk/?p=1831
- Wikipedia, Steinway D-274: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steinway_D-274

questions.q: How much does a grand piano weigh?
questions.a: A nine-foot concert grand such as the Steinway Model D weighs about 990 pounds (480 kg).

questions.q: Why shouldn't you microwave fish at work?
questions.a: Reheated fish releases strong-smelling compounds that fill shared break rooms, which is why many offices ban it.

questions.q: How long is a concert grand piano?
questions.a: About 9 feet: the Steinway Model D is 274 cm (8 ft 11 3/4 in) long.
